CustomField.inlineHelpText: How severe would the impact be if access to application (and our data within) was interrupted or unavailable for more than 24 hours? *
CustomField.label: Service Interruption Impact

value.fullName: High (The most impact on the organization, mission, and other networks and systems. The business cannot function if the service is down for more than 24 hours.)
value.label: High

value.fullName: Medium (A moderate problem to the organization and possibly other networks or systems. Affects a smaller subset of users.)
value.label: Medium

value.fullName: Low (Little impact, damage or disruption to the organization. No loss, but lost efficiency. Alternative software or manual process would exist.)
value.label: Low
